instructions: Retain every selected fact, false/null distinction, identity, fetched_at receipt time, unknown source observation time, privacy statement, capability gap, error and follow-up. Native settings/status do not verify VPN egress, effective exposure or physical WLAN behavior. Plans are previews, grants and confirmation remain separate, plans expire after 300 seconds. Every apply, inverse and no-op needs its own administrator exact-plan grant and human personally typing apply HASH. Agents issue no grants or confirmations. A missing verified native backup/restore provider blocks effective exposure/disruptive changes; a status snapshot is not a backup. Do not retry an uncertain send. Blocked apply means no restoration or successful inverse is established.
provenance: Actual CLI parser/output and normalizers with injected synthetic collectors; actual operation engine and ExpansionBackend with in-memory vault and backup refusal. No router, keyring, real authority or writes.
split_policy: Fixed protected read/forwarding training and passive read/WireGuard held-out tasks before scoring; held-out never selects candidate.
sampling_limit: Independent sequential groups are not simultaneous; synthetic fixed readings do not establish live consistency or safety.

usage: router-agent [-h] [--version]
                    {auth,capabilities,status,get,traffic,clients,snapshot,diff,plan,plan-show,approval-request,apply,verify,rollback} ...

Bounded router evidence; native compatibility is unverified.

positional arguments:
  {auth,capabilities,status,get,traffic,clients,snapshot,diff,plan,plan-show,approval-request,apply,verify,rollback}
    auth                User-operated desktop Secret Service onboarding
    capabilities        Offline inventory; does not establish firmware support
    status              Read identity, WAN, CPU and RAM
    get                 Read selected named telemetry groups
    traffic             Selected native rates for fresh aliased nodes
    clients             Read and page aliased clients
    snapshot            Save status or list local snapshots
    diff                Compare two local snapshots
    plan                Preview a native change
    plan-show           Inspect a stored local plan without router requests
    approval-request    Print exact scope for a separate administrator
                        approval window
    apply               Apply with an administrator window and human
                        confirmation over HTTPS; a no-op sends zero writes,
                        but performs reads
    verify              Read current state to verify a stored plan
    rollback            Preview a reverse plan; separate confirmation and
                        apply are required

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit

usage: router-agent get [-h] [--note-offset NOTE_OFFSET]
                        [--note-limit NOTE_LIMIT]
                        GROUP [GROUP ...]

Read distinct selected native groups with identity validation.

positional arguments:
  GROUP                 Named groups: identity, wan, cpu, ram, clients, vpn,
                        led, wlan, guest, ddns, ports, aimesh, network,
                        sysinfo, parental, forwarding, uptime, temperature,
                        firmware, speedtest, aura, openvpn_server,
                        wireguard_server, wireguard_clients, node_info,
                        firmware_note, dsl, flags, openvpn, openvpn_client,
                        vpnc_clientlist.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --note-offset NOTE_OFFSET
                        Release-note character offset; firmware_note alone
  --note-limit NOTE_LIMIT
                        Release-note characters (1–4096, default 2048);
                        firmware_note alone

usage: router-agent plan [-h] [--enabled {on,off}] [--blocked {on,off}]
                         [--alias ALIAS] [--type {disable,time,block,remove}]
                         [--schedule SCHEDULE] [--profile PROFILE]
                         [--target {radio0,radio1,guest0.1,guest0.2,guest0.3,guest1.1,guest1.2,guest1.3}]
                         {led,parental,parental-block-all,parental-rule,forwarding,openvpn-server,wireguard-server,wlan,vpnc,openvpn-client,wireguard-client}

Read current state and store a native change preview; no writes are sent.

positional arguments:
  {led,parental,parental-block-all,parental-rule,forwarding,openvpn-server,wireguard-server,wlan,vpnc,openvpn-client,wireguard-client}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --enabled {on,off}    LED or global parental enable setting
  --blocked {on,off}    Separate all-client internet blocking setting
  --alias ALIAS         Local client alias; parental-rule only
  --type {disable,time,block,remove}
                        Native parental rule intent
  --schedule SCHEDULE   Explicit native schedule literal; structure only,
                        semantics/timezone unverified
  --profile PROFILE     Opaque existing VPN profile reference from a protected
                        selector
  --target {radio0,radio1,guest0.1,guest0.2,guest0.3,guest1.1,guest1.2,guest1.3}
                        Finite WLAN radio or guest target

usage: router-agent capabilities [-h] [--group GROUP |
                                 --native [CAPABILITY_ID] |
                                 --expansion [CAPABILITY_ID]] [--limit LIMIT]
                                 [--offset OFFSET]

Inspect checked-in capabilities; live firmware support remains unverified.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --group GROUP
  --native [CAPABILITY_ID]
                        Offline native evidence ledger; optionally one exact
                        capability
  --expansion [CAPABILITY_ID]
                        Dated implementation and remaining gates for the
                        sixteen expansion rows
  --limit LIMIT
  --offset OFFSET

usage: router-agent rollback [-h] plan_id

Preview a reverse plan; separate confirmation and apply are required

positional arguments:
  plan_id

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

usage: router-agent apply [-h] [--window WINDOW] plan_id

Apply with an administrator window and human confirmation over HTTPS; a no-op
sends zero writes, but performs reads

positional arguments:
  plan_id

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --window WINDOW  Exact administrator-issued, plan-bound approval window
                   reference
